text: OSPF is a link-state routing protocol used to exchange routing information between routers
BGP is a path vector routing protocol used mainly for exchanging routes between autonomous systems
VLANs allow a network to be logically divided into multiple broadcast domains
STP prevents Layer 2 switching loops by creating a loop-free topology
EtherChannel combines multiple physical links into one logical link
Python is a high-level programming language commonly used for automation and data processing
Functions in Python allow developers to organize reusable pieces of code
Machine learning enables systems to learn patterns from data and make predictions
Embeddings represent text as numerical vectors that capture semantic information
Cosine similarity measures how similar two vectors are based on their direction
